video_title: LeBron on Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey and the Philadelphia 76ers | BEST OF MIND THE GAME

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey's impressive development and work ethic in Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese Maxey has been taking a leap after leap after leap over the last few years.
quotes.quote: The best thing about our league is when you see guys take that next leap from one year to the next. Two guys in particular for me, obviously we have seen the first guy I am going to talk about because he has been taking a leap after leap after leap over the last few years is Tyrese Maxey. I have worked out and trained with him over the last few summers. Every morning at 5:00 a.m. or 5:30 a.m. in the gym, you just see his dedication. He shows up on time, on target every single day. A guy who just loves the game and is taking full advantage of the opportunity in Philadelphia.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: Any time he's healthy he's on the floor. And Tyrese Maxey could very well easily be a first team.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: What do you make of this Philadelphia team if they are healthy? I mean, this is a talented team.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: They have Joel Embiid, MVP caliber type of player. Any time he is healthy he is on the floor. And Tyrese Maxey could very well easily be a first team All-NBA guy on any given year the way he has been playing. And a young talent who will be first team all-rookie. When they are rolling, when Embiid is playing, he is in the mid-range, he is on the low block, he is motivated. Maxey is burning down the highway, playing on the autobahn, shooting his step-back threes, getting into the lane. They have the ability to put up 140 on you on any given night.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Maxey's historic game-winning shot rate in playoffs

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: Tyrese has hit a game-winner in 13% of his career playoff games since 1996-97. The next highest rate is Chris Middleton, 5%, and Damian Lillard, 4.6%. So you have combined Chris Middleton and Damian Lillard plus more.

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
text_blocks.text: Appreciate it, bro. That is dope.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's response to Boston Celtics injury narrative
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown basically said the hell with your narrative, I am about to go crazy.
quotes.quote: I want to talk about guys taking advantage of injuries and also losing personnel. We look at the Celtics. The Celtics lost Jayson Tatum to injury. They lost Al Horford to another team, Jrue Holiday to another team, Cornet to another team, and Kristaps Porzingis went to Atlanta. They came into the season and a lot of people were saying it might be lottery for the Celtics. Jaylen Brown basically said the hell with your narrative, I am about to go crazy. We have to give some flowers to Jaylen Brown.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Maxey
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's efficiency and mid-range game
quotes.excerpt: Outside of 12 feet he's 48% on contested twos. That is ridiculous.
quotes.quote: He is playing unbelievable. I think he is doing a great job of just playing within the flow. I feel like he is not going out of his way to mess up what they have going offensively. There is a stat here that outside of 12 feet he is 48% on contested twos. That is ridiculous. That does not even make sense. He is only behind Jayson Tatum and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander in makes. That is hard to do because especially where our league is now, you live with the mid-range two. There are some guys that can beat you with the mid-range two. And the way he is playing right now is unbelievable.
